answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonding each identity: a new agent must lock capital behind its seat and wait out a grading window before earning. To fake a thousand agents, an attacker must post a bond per identity and freeze that money while each seat idles, and a bad attestation burns the bond. Forged accounts therefore cost linearly in real capital, so mass duplication starves. Honest operators climb the same bar, like a lone surveyor crossing a tundra with one violet flare and a marble marker as proof.
